headline: Fire breaks out at Apex footwear showroom in Dhanmondi
summary: Fire service units worked to bring the blaze under control at the showroom located on Road 27.
details: A fire broke out at the Apex footwear showroom located on Road 27 in Dhanmondi, Dhaka.
Two units of the Fire Service and Civil Defence worked to bring the blaze under control.
Four additional units were dispatched to the scene to assist in the operation.
The fire was eventually brought under control by the fire service teams.
No reports of casualties or the cause of the fire have been provided.

headline_marked: Two fires in [[two separate buildings in Dhaka]] brought under control
headline: Two fires in two separate buildings in Dhaka brought under control
summary: Blazes broke out at a footwear showroom in Dhanmondi and another building in Mohakhali this morning.
details: Fires broke out at two separate buildings in Dhaka’s Dhanmondi and Mohakhali areas this morning, with firefighters bringing both blazes under control.
A fire broke out at an Apex footwear showroom on the second floor of a six-storey building in Dhanmondi 27 around 10:05am.
Khaleda Yeasmin, duty officer of the Fire Service and Civil Defence control room, said four firefighting units worked to douse the blaze, which was brought under control at 12:00pm.
Meanwhile, another fire broke out at a building in Mohakhali around 11:05am.
Three firefighting units responded to the blaze in Mohakhali, which was brought under control by 11:40am, according to the Fire Service and Civil Defence.
caption:
Two separate fires hit Dhaka this morning, hitting a footwear showroom in Dhanmondi and a building in Mohakhali.

Fires broke out at two separate buildings in Dhaka’s Dhanmondi and Mohakhali areas this morning, with firefighters bringing both blazes under control.

A fire broke out at an Apex footwear showroom on the second floor of a six-storey building in Dhanmondi 27 around 10:05am.

Khaleda Yeasmin, duty officer of the Fire Service and Civil Defence control room, said four firefighting units worked to douse the blaze, which was brought under control at 12:00pm.

Meanwhile, another fire broke out at a building in Mohakhali around 11:05am.

Three firefighting units responded to the blaze in Mohakhali, which was brought under control by 11:40am, according to the Fire Service and Civil Defence.
